component.name: CloudDrop
component.summary: Keep a folder uploaded to Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox and more

description.p: CloudDrop uploads everything you put in a folder to your cloud, keeping the same folder structure: Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Nextcloud or another WebDAV server, S3-compatible storage, SFTP or MEGA. It only ever uploads: deleting a file on your computer never deletes it in the cloud, so you can free up disk space and still download any file back later.

ul.li: New and edited files are uploaded automatically, edits become new versions
Renames and moves are applied in Drive without uploading again
Large uploads resume after a network drop, a reboot or a crash
Free up space only after checking that the cloud copy is identical
Several folders, each uploading to a cloud of its own
A top-bar icon shows progress and lets you pause uploads

description.p: CloudDrop talks to your cloud directly, so your files never pass through a third-party server, and it asks for as little access as each cloud allows: on Google Drive only the files it creates, on OneDrive and Dropbox only its own app folder.
